user.title: Aqara Presence Lab
user.description: Add Aqara cloud observations while keeping HomeKit and existing automations unchanged. Sign in with your Aqara account or first preview historical examples.

offline.title: Offline preview — historical examples
offline.description: Historical example data from 25 September 2026: Sensor A reported 9 lx, Sensor B 110 lx. Both presence candidates contained the raw code 0; its meaning and freshness are unverified. These examples create no devices, entities or network requests. Coordinates, person count and sleep data are not available.

credentials.title: Sign in to Aqara (EU)
credentials.description:
Enter your account and password locally. Both are stored in secrets.yaml after validation and final confirmation. Enter the desired device IDs, one per line; there is no automatic device discovery.

Login and device reads share a cooldown of at least 30 seconds. The progress screen remains open during this wait.

devices.title: Devices and polling
devices.description: Select the devices whose cloud responses were received. The interval applies to one shared account batch. Illuminance is the last reported cloud value; it is not a promise of a current physical measurement.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew session
reauth_confirm.description: Automatic sign-in needs your help. Devices and history remain in place. Sign in again with the same account or choose updated secret names. The existing selection is checked before replacing the session.

reconfigure.title: Recheck account and devices
reconfigure.description: Account identity must stay unchanged. After sign-in you can change the device selection and polling interval.

live.title: Allow experimental cloud access
live.description:
Allow the integration to sign in to your Aqara account, read selected devices and automatically renew expired sessions. Account and password are stored locally in secrets.yaml or resolved using existing secret names; session tokens use a separate private HA store. Administrators and backups may have access to these values.

The private Aqara interface is experimental: long-term reliability and measurement freshness are unverified. Reads use the observed subscription behavior. MFA or CAPTCHA may require manual action. Enter your password only here locally, never in issues or chats.

data.allow_experimental_cloud: Allow experimental access and automatic sign-in

login_source.title: Choose credentials
login_source.description: Use credentials for your Aqara EU account. The server establishes account identity; only explicitly selected device IDs are read.

secrets.title: Use existing secrets
secrets.description: Enter only the names of two entries in secrets.yaml in the HA configuration directory, for example aqara_account and aqara_password. Values are resolved locally and are not stored in this integration’s configuration entry. Enter desired device IDs, one per line.

error.invalid_capture: The export is incomplete or not a single JSON document. Export it again locally; do not post credentials.
error.missing_credentials: Enter both your account and password, or provide both existing account and password entry names from secrets.yaml.
error.signature_rejected: The signed request was rejected. Check the session, protocol profile and clock; repeated logins will not resolve an unverified signature.
error.cannot_connect: Aqara is temporarily unreachable. The integration will respect its retry delay.
error.rate_limited: Aqara is limiting requests. Wait for the shared cooldown before trying again.
error.auth_required: Sign-in failed or the session is no longer valid. Check the account, password and any additional verification in the Aqara app. The integration will not keep retrying sign-in.
error.account_mismatch: This session belongs to a different account. Use the configured account; existing devices have not been reassigned.
error.no_selected_device_data: No usable response was received for the selection. Check the device IDs and Aqara app mode.
error.freshness_unverified: A cloud value was reported, but its physical measurement freshness is unverified.
error.api_changed: Aqara returned an unrecognized response. Check the protocol and use the sanitized diagnostic export.
error.unsupported_region: Only the observed EU region is supported. No other regional host will be tried.
error.invalid_device_ids: Enter one to 100 device IDs, one per line, without whitespace inside an ID.
error.invalid_interval: Choose an interval from 60 to 3600 seconds.
error.protocol_unsupported: This access method is unsupported or has not been explicitly allowed. Check sign-in and the protocol profile.
error.consent_required: Allow experimental cloud access and automatic sign-in to continue.
error.secret_not_found: At least one secret name is missing from local secrets.yaml. Check the entries and spelling.
error.secret_store_failed: Credentials could not be read or stored safely. Check secrets.yaml and file permissions.
error.unknown: Sign-in could not be completed. Check the sanitized integration diagnostics.

init.title: Polling intervals
init.description: Status and vital observations take priority; settings are read less often. Intervals are per-device targets; all account requests share one minimum spacing. The default is 30 seconds. Shorter spacing is experimental and falls back to 30 seconds on errors. Faster polling does not guarantee fresher measurements.

error.invalid_interval: Interval is outside the displayed range or is not a whole number.

benchmark_polling.name: Benchmark polling
benchmark_polling.description: Starts at most ten status reads at 15, 10 and 5 second minimum spacing. Stops on the first error, restores the previous profile and exposes only sanitized statistics in integration diagnostics. Administrators only; requires an existing healthy session.
